name.description: Skill identifier. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must match the parent folder name.

description.description: Description of what the skill does.

paths.description: File paths this skill applies to (glob patterns).

disable-model-invocation.description: Whether to disable model invocation for this skill.

color.description: Hex color code for UI display (e.g., #ff0000).

scripts.description: Explicit references to script packages (directory names under the skill).
